hooks.prompt:
You receive session context as JSON. Check whether the '/morpheus-fix-my-bug' skill was actually invoked and executed in this session (not just discussed or mentioned). If it was NOT invoked, respond ONLY with {"decision": "allow"} — no explanation, no other text.

Only if '/morpheus-fix-my-bug' was genuinely invoked, verify ALL of the following steps were completed:
1. Bug was reproduced (smallest failing case exists)
2. Skill(superpowers-systematic-debugging) was invoked
3. Skill(superpowers-test-driven-development) was invoked and a failing test was written
4. The fix was applied and the test now passes
5. detect_changes was called
6. get_test_targets was called
7. check_guards was called
8. analyze kind=dead_code was called
9. contracts action=check was called
10. Skill(superpowers-verification-before-completion) was invoked
11. Skill(superpowers-requesting-code-review) was invoked
12. feedback action=record was called

If all steps are complete, respond ONLY with {"decision": "allow"}.
If any step is missing, respond ONLY with {"decision": "block", "reason": "Missing required step: <step name>"}.
Respond with JSON only — no explanation, no other text.
